title: Unique natural coefficient tensor balancing
statement: For a scheme W, sheaves R and S of commutative rings on its pro-etale site, a ring-sheaf map phi : R to S, and an S-module sheaf N, there is a unique natural isomorphism in the R-module sheaf M from the restriction to R of (S tensor_R M) tensor_S N to M tensor_R (N restricted to R); here extension and restriction of scalars along phi are those of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], and the ordinary module-sheaf tensor product and its local pure tensors are those of [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model]. It sends each local pure tensor (s tensor x) tensor z to x tensor (s times z). No flatness assumption is required.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1), coefficient-model proof Step 7; Stacks 03EK and 06YY (ordinary tensor balancing).

proof.text: Specialize the proved ordinaryTensorCancellation comparison to the recorded extension functor, using its existing object equality with ordinary change of rings and its map formula. Invert the component comparison. Its naturality in the module M, with N fixed, constructs a natural isomorphism by NatIso.ofComponents. Its local tensor formula gives the required normalization. For uniqueness, precompose a candidate component with the forward cancellation map and apply local tensor-generator extensionality through sheafification. Set the scalar s to one in the normalization to prove equality on each generator. Componentwise and natural-transformation extensionality then prove equality of the natural isomorphisms. This also handles the empty scheme and zero modules; when phi is the identity it is the usual tensor cancellation associativity map.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportCoefficientModels_balancing_existsUnique
    (W : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
    (φ : R ⟶ S) (N : pbcModules W S) :
    ∃! α : pbcExtend φ ⋙ (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor W S).flip.obj N ⋙ pbcRestrict φ ≅
      (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor W R).flip.obj ((pbcRestrict φ).obj N),
      ∀ (M : pbcModules W R) (V : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (s : S.obj.obj V)
        (x : M.val.obj V) (z : N.val.obj V),
        (α.hom.app M).val.app V
            (proEtaleTensorPair W S ((pbcExtend φ).obj M) N V
              (pbcTensorSection φ M V s x) z) =
          proEtaleTensorPair W R M ((pbcRestrict φ).obj N) V x
            (@SMul.smul _ _ (N.val.obj V).isModule.toSMul s z)
